issues.issue: Did the Refugee Protection Division fail to observe natural justice by not properly notifying the applicant of hearings, justifying reopening the claim?
issues.applicant_position: Applicant claims she did not receive hearing notices due to address change and inability to communicate with lawyer or CIC.
issues.respondent_position: Minister argues no failure of natural justice; applicant did not notify RPD in writing of address change; notices sent to address on file.
issues.result_text: No failure of natural justice; notices sent to address on file; applicant failed to notify RPD in writing of address change.
